title: 第3273章 埋伏揭穿第3272章 蛮夷畏威而不怀德
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
门口站着的正是杏儿。
她显然得到了龙婆的指示，在秦伏天打开房门后目光快速朝房间中扫了一眼。
发现房间中一片宁静，秦伏天和苏晚棠面色如常，仿佛什么事情都没遇到，不禁有些疑惑。
“龙婆不是说，这里可能死人了吗？难道杀手没过来？”
杏儿心中十分疑惑，快速收拾好表情，说道：“两位客人，龙婆和方小姐请你们过去吃早餐。”
秦伏天无意刁难一个普通女人，示意苏晚棠将东西都带上，跟着杏儿朝餐厅走去。
刚来到餐厅所在楼层，秦伏天眉头顿时皱了起来。
这里没有监控，可他却从一些隐蔽的角落中感受到了强烈的注视感，甚至有一丝丝危机感。
趁着杏儿不备，秦伏天稍稍放慢了脚步，元神之力成直线，朝着最近的一处角落探去。
就见一个普通男人手持枪械，正躲在暗处，森冷的盯着秦伏天和苏晚棠两人。
“昨天晚上那名鬼修没有回去找龙婆，引起了龙婆的警惕，看样子她是打算用强了。别墅中安排了这么多人，外面的人恐怕更多。”
秦伏天心中暗道。
手指轻轻一点，一道细如发丝的剑气猛地射出，扎穿木门，一剑刺死了躲在门后的男人。
命中的瞬间，剑气中蕴含的冰之法则力量瞬间爆发，将男人整个人连带脚下的地板彻底冻住。
秦伏天动用的法则之力非常小，小得就像一颗肉眼无法看到的灰烬。
可就这点力量，却足要命，甚至整个过程没有发出任何声音。
弄死了一个，秦伏天如法炮制，一路将所有埋伏的人灭口。
等走到餐厅的时候，别墅中的温度都因为冰雕太多下降了两度。
此时，方淼淼和龙婆已经在餐桌前坐好，但两人的气氛却不太好，甚至有针锋相对的意思。
看到秦伏天和苏晚棠过来，身上没有任何伤口，方淼淼才松了口气。

“我还有事，两位朋友，不如我们早点离开吧，等去了繁花镇我再好好招待两位。”方淼淼直接站起身来，勉强扯出笑容说道。
龙婆探究地在秦伏天和苏晚棠身上扫视片刻，淡淡的问：“两位客人看起来休息的不错？”
龙婆的语气虽然平淡，可在知道内情的秦伏天、苏晚棠耳中，试探的味道十分明显。
苏晚棠想起昨天晚上秦伏天突然睡着，自己却连发生了什么都不知道，顿时冷声说道：“不错，太不错！真是感谢你们的‘热情’招待！”
苏晚棠在“热情”两字上咬了重音，却懒得表现出不满的情绪。
可惜，性格软糯的她连骂人都不会，看起来就像一只努力表现出凶狠模样的小奶猫，毫无杀伤力。
秦伏天淡淡的道：“你不如直接问，夺舍成功了没有。”
龙婆脸色大变，猛地站了起来：“你做了什么？”
旁边的方淼淼立刻感觉不对，疑惑地问道：“夺舍？什么夺舍？”
她见龙婆没回答，又转头望向秦伏天。
“昨天晚上，有一只炼气六层的鬼修闯入了我们的房间，想要夺舍我的身体。可惜，我技高一筹，没让他得手。”秦伏天说道。
听到这话，龙婆知道事情已经败露，脸色顿时难看起来。
“小子，你不过是个练气一层的蝼蚁，那位大人可是练气六层的强者，你到底耍了什么花招？”
龙婆无论如何都不敢相信，秦伏天能够解决镇守在这里的鬼修。
content_en:
The person standing at the door was Xing'er.
She obviously got instructions from Long Po. After Qin Futian opened the door, she quickly glanced at the room.
Finding that the room was quiet, Qin Futian and Su Wantang looked as usual, as if nothing had happened, and they couldn't help but feel a little confused.
"Didn't Luang Po say that someone might have died here? Didn't the killer come?"
Xing'er was very confused, she quickly cleared up her expression and said, "Two guests, Long Po and Miss Fang, please come over for breakfast."
Qin Futian had no intention of making things difficult for an ordinary woman, so he motioned to Su Wantang to take everything with her and follow Xing'er towards the restaurant.
As soon as he arrived at the restaurant floor, Qin Futian frowned.
There was no surveillance here, but he felt a strong sense of gaze from some hidden corners, and even a slight sense of crisis.
Taking advantage of Xing'er's unpreparedness, Qin Futian slowed down his pace slightly, and used the power of his soul in a straight line to explore the nearest corner.
I saw an ordinary man holding a gun, hiding in the dark, staring coldly at Qin Futian and Su Wantang.
"The ghost cultivator did not go back to find Long Po last night, which aroused Long Po's vigilance. It seems that she is planning to use force. With so many people arranged in the villa, there may be even more people outside."
Qin Futian thought to himself.
With a tap of his finger, a sword energy as thin as a hair shot out suddenly, pierced the wooden door, and stabbed the man hiding behind the door to death.
The moment it hit, the power of the Law of Ice contained in the sword energy exploded instantly, completely freezing the man and the floor beneath his feet.
The power of law used by Qin Futian was very small, as small as an ashes that could not be seen by the naked eye.
But this little power was enough to kill him, and he didn't even make any sound during the whole process.
After killing one, Qin Futian followed suit and killed all the people who were ambushing him.
When we walked to the restaurant, the temperature in the villa dropped two degrees due to too many ice sculptures.
At this time, Fang Miaomiao and Long Po had already sat down at the dining table, but the atmosphere between the two was not very good, and they even seemed to be tit for tat.
Fang Miaomiao was relieved when he saw Qin Futian and Su Wantang coming over without any wounds on their bodies.
"I still have something to do, two friends, why don't we leave early, and I will entertain you two well when we get to Fanhua Town." Fang Miaomiao stood up directly and said with a forced smile.
Long Po glanced at Qin Futian and Su Wantang inquiringly for a moment, and asked lightly: "The two guests seem to have a good rest?"
Although Long Po's tone was calm, the sound of probing was very obvious in the ears of Qin Futian and Su Wantang, who knew the inside story.
Su Wantang remembered that Qin Futian suddenly fell asleep last night, but he didn't even know what happened. He suddenly said coldly: "Not bad, very good! Thank you very much for your 'warm' reception!"
Su Wantang emphasized the word "enthusiasm" but was too lazy to show dissatisfaction.
It's a pity that she has a soft personality and can't even curse. She looks like a little kitten trying to look fierce and has no lethality.
Qin Futian said calmly: "You might as well ask directly if the seizure was successful."
Luang Po's face changed drastically and he stood up suddenly: "What did you do?"
Fang Miaomiao, who was next to him, immediately felt something was wrong and asked doubtfully: "Seizing the body? What seizing the body?"
Seeing that Long Po didn't answer, she turned to look at Qin Futian.
"Last night, a ghost cultivator at the sixth level of Qi Refining broke into our room and wanted to take away my body. Unfortunately, I was superior and didn't let him succeed," Qin Futian said.
Hearing this, Luang Po knew that the matter had been revealed, and his face suddenly turned ugly.
"Boy, you are just an ant at the first level of Qi training. That adult is a strong man at the sixth level of Qi training. What tricks did you play?"
No matter what, Long Po couldn't believe that Qin Futian could deal with the ghost cultivators guarding here.
